text: This code is a straightforward and efficient implementation of the task. It iterates through the list, keeping track of the index of the smallest element encountered so far. The variable `best` is initialized to the index of the first element, and then updated whenever a smaller element is found. This approach ensures that the index of the first occurrence of the minimum element is returned, as required by the task. The code is simple, easy to understand, and has a time complexity of O(n), making it suitable for large lists.
